title: Local fuel cut with a wider disk kills one dividing CIPS condensate while its neighbours keep theirs: seed 1 target dissolves by t~600 after the cut (221 -> 0 px), seed 0 target is starved to a 32-px remnant (from 248); fed twins and all 17 outside bodies unchanged
summary: Follows 20261026T1210-c40-cips-local-cut, where a disk of radius 0.6x the nearest-neighbour distance only shrank the target. Same world (the layered dividing CIPS world of 20261026T1100-c40-cips-layered-divide-claim, unchanged) and cut.py, now with the disk radius at 0.75x the distance to the nearest other body (35-36 px for neighbours 47-48 px away, so each neighbour's edge, ~8 px from its centre, stays outside). kF=0 inside the disk from t=12000, fed twin branched from the same state. Seed 1: the target's area (e>0.5) falls 221 -> 90 -> 43 -> 0 px by t=12600 and the condensate is gone (cutw_s1.png); seed 0: 248 -> 47 px by t=12200, then a starved remnant of 32-52 px to t=13475 (cutw_s0.png). Fed twins: 248-251 and 221-222 px. Bodies outside the disk: 17 throughout in both arms, both seeds (cutw_timecourse.png). Together with the 0.6x disk (shrinks to 35-45%) this is a per-individual supply ablation: each body's size and, with enough of its supply cut, its existence depend on its own fuel.

finding.operator: local feed cut (kF=0 in a disk of 0.75x the nearest-neighbour distance around one body) in cooperative CIPS on a consumed, regrowing fuel
finding.control: fed twin branched from the same state at t=12000, seeds 0 and 1; the 17 bodies outside the disk
finding.result: seed 1 target 221 -> 0 px by t=12600 (dead); seed 0 248 -> 32-52 px remnant to t=13475; fed twins unchanged; 17 outside bodies kept in both arms

limits: Death on 1 of 2 seeds within 1500 t; on seed 0 fuel diffusing across the disk edge keeps a remnant alive. One cut time, one disk size per run; the disk also removes fuel regrowth from the bath between bodies, not only the target's own uptake.
